name: Wand of Paralysis

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Paralyzing Ray
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: a thin blue ray at a creature within 60 ft: a DC 15 Con save or Paralyzed for 1 minute (save again at the end of each of its turns).

summary: 7 charges: a ray that Paralyzes a creature for up to a minute (Con DC 15).
text: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 of its charges to cause a thin blue ray to streak from the tip toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.
